name: strangeverse
description: StrangeVerse - multi-agent simulation and scenario graphs

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv sync --group dev && uv run python -m pytest tests/ -v
